metadata.name: countyroot
metadata.description: CountyRoot: Merkle roots of U.S. county parcel extracts on Solana

instructions.name: post_root
docs: Deprecated: bypasses the CountyHead pointer and provenance. Use post_root_v2.
Kept in the interface so old clients get a clear error instead of an unknown instruction.

instructions.name: update_root
docs: Deprecated (decision D2): posted roots are immutable; corrections are new epochs.

instructions.name: retract_root
docs: Deprecated: no reason, no head update. Use retract_root_v2.

instructions.name: post_root_v2
docs: Post a new epoch with provenance. Epochs are monotonic per county
(epoch == head.latest_epoch + 1; a brand-new county starts at 1). If the previous
latest epoch is still ACTIVE it must be passed as `prev_root` and is marked
SUPERSEDED in the same transaction.

accounts.name: prev_root
docs: Previous latest epoch; required when it is still ACTIVE (address checked in the handler).

instructions.name: retract_root_v2
docs: Retract an ACTIVE or SUPERSEDED root with a reason (PII, SOURCE_ERROR, DUPLICATE,
BUILD_ERROR, OTHER). Retracting the latest active epoch leaves the county with no
active root (latest_active_epoch = 0) until a new epoch is posted (decision D5).

instructions.name: init_head
docs: DEVNET MIGRATION ONLY. Create the CountyHead for a county whose latest posted
epoch is `latest_epoch` (must exist and be ACTIVE). The caller (the migration
script) is responsible for checking that no higher epoch exists.

instructions.name: migrate_root
docs: DEVNET MIGRATION ONLY. Grow a legacy 98/99-byte ACTIVE root to the 256-byte v2
layout and record its provenance (flags.migrated = 1, posted_slot = 0 = unknown).
Bytes 0..98 (the original account body) are never touched.

instructions.name: mark_superseded
docs: DEVNET MIGRATION ONLY. Mark an older ACTIVE epoch as SUPERSEDED by a later one.
Works on 98/99-byte accounts (status lives in the original body) without realloc.

instructions.name: set_paused
docs: Authority-only emergency stop. Idempotent: setting the current value succeeds
(and still emits PauseChanged with old == new), so unpause can always be retried safely.

instructions.name: set_attestor
docs: Authority-only attestor rotation. Deliberately ignores `paused`, so a compromised
attestor can be swapped while writes are frozen.

instructions.name: propose_authority
docs: Step 1 of config-authority rotation. Current authority only; works while paused.
Creates or overwrites the single PendingAuthority PDA (the authority pays rent).

instructions.name: accept_authority
docs: Step 2. Must be signed by the proposed key (a normal signer, or a PDA such as a
Squads vault signing via invoke_signed). Works while paused. Closes the pending
account and returns its rent to the proposer who paid for it.

instructions.name: cancel_authority
docs: Current authority only; works while paused. Closes the pending account (rent to proposer).

fields.name: latest_active_epoch
docs: 0 = no active root (latest was retracted).

fields.name: manifest_sha256
docs: sha256 of the canonical manifest JSON bytes as published.

fields.name: source_sha256
docs: sha256 of the raw county download (all zero only for migrated roots whose raw file was not archived).

fields.name: packet_sha256
docs: sha256 of the published packet CSV.

fields.name: data_as_of
docs: County's own edit date (unix seconds), 0 if the county does not expose one.

fields.name: fetched_at
docs: When CountyRoot downloaded the extract (unix seconds, UTC).

fields.name: leaf_version
docs: Leaf recipe: 1 or 2.
Appended last so older decoders that ignore trailing bytes keep working.
